positions.thesis: Munich Re raised its 2026 profit target to EUR 6.6bn with Q3 results (9M net result EUR 5.7bn); the screen shows a rare leader in a weak tape: +4.2% 20d vs median -5.4%, 11.7% above SMA200, 2.5% off its 52w high, RSI 58.5, low 25.6% volatility. Rate-sensitive, non-tech earnings and EUR exposure suit a defensive regime; next results are not due until late February.

Iberdrola grew 9M-2026 net profit ~10% to EUR 5.8bn on record investment and raised its 2026 outlook (targets a record year); screen shows a steady leader: +3.9% 20d, +13.7% 60d, 11.2% above SMA200, 3.7% off its 52w high, RSI 58, very low 16.4% volatility. Adds utilities/Spain exposure; FY results not due until late February.
